stem.text: Esters can be hydrolysed with an aqueous alkali or an aqueous acid to form two products.
The table compares the two methods.

A.text: complete conversion to a salt and an organic acid; forms an equilibrium mixture with an organic acid and an alcohol

B.text: forms an equilibrium mixture with a salt and an organic acid; complete conversion to a salt and an alcohol

C.text: complete conversion to a salt and an alcohol; forms an equilibrium mixture with an organic acid and an alcohol

D.text: complete conversion to a salt and an alcohol; complete conversion to an organic acid and an alcohol
